Access to Health Records and Reports Act 1993
ACCESS TO HEALTH RECORDS AND REPORTS
(HEALTH PROFESSIONALS) REGULATIONS 19961
Approved by Tynwald: 21 May 1996
Coming into Operation: 1 June 1996
In exercise of the powers conferred on the Department of Health and Social Security by
section 10 of the Access to Health Records and Reports Act 19931, and of all other
enabling powers, the following Regulations are hereby made: —
1 Citation, interpretation and commencement
(1) These Regulations may be cited as the Access to Health Records and
Reports (Health Professionals) Regulations 1996 and, subject to section
11(3) of the Act, shall come into operation on the 1st June 1996.
(2) In these Regulations “the Act” means the Access to Health Records and
Reports Act 1993.
2 Additional categories of health professional for purposes of Act
(1) The professions related or supplementary to medicine which are specified
in column 1 of the Schedule are specified for the purposes of the definition
of “health professional” in section 10 of the Act.
(2) A member of such a profession shall not be treated as a health professional
unless he fulfils the condition specified in relation thereto in column 2 of
the Schedule.
